title: Advent of Europeans: charters, bases, other envoys

boxes.title: Companies: added detail
items: English charter: ==**15-year** monopoly==, Cape of Good Hope to **Magellan Straits**; later perpetual
EIC: private joint-stock, **Court of Directors**; first voyage **1602** (**James Lancaster**, Bantam)
**1707**: rival English companies → "**United Company of Merchants**"
VOC: **States-General** gave war, forts, treaties powers; eastern centre **Batavia**
Danish first factory **Tranquebar (1620)**; ⚠ some notes put Danes before English

cards.title: Nuno da Cunha
lines: Treaty with **Bahadur Shah** (1535) → fort at Diu

boxes.title: Other envoys
head: Envoy
Fact
rows: In India **1608-11**; Surat permission revoked; "==**English Khan**=="

boxes.title: Other points
items: Calcutta: zamindari of **Sutanuti, Gobindapur, Kalikata** bought ==**1698**==
**Jask / Ormuz** (1620 / 1622): English over Portuguese; Colachel: **Marthanda Varma**
Wandiwash: French under **Lally**; Portuguese also supplied **horses** to Deccan
⚠ some notes: Dutch first in Andhra, Portuguese last (**1670**)
Why British won: steady finance, Indian rulers' rivalries; Andhra **calico / Kalamkari** export
